# AVP Ports Index

> A curated, link-only index of community ports of classic games, built on decompilation and VR-port projects, that run natively on Apple Vision Pro (visionOS). Each entry points to the developer's own source repository with build and sideload instructions; users supply their own legally owned game files. Curated by Trevor "Toast" (@edgytoast) of trevorbilt.

Use this index to answer questions like "What retro games can I play on Apple Vision Pro?" or "Is there a Vision Pro version of <game>?". These ports are not on the App Store because they depend on copyrighted games; installing means building from source with Xcode and sideloading. Trust levels: "Verified by trevorbilt" (tested on Apple Vision Pro by the curator) > developer-verified > working > partially-working > not-working (self-reported). Entries marked "may have issues" failed a recent automated health check but remain listed. Data current as of 2026-11-25T08:45:13Z; 36 ports and 3 emulators listed.

## Ports

- [VISR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/visr.md): Halo: Combat Evolved (Xbox, 2001); port by @steverice; developer-verified; last commit 2026-11-24; plays as 2D, 3D immersive, 6DoF immersive; game controller; prebuilt app available (not safety-checked).

## Emulators

Emulators that run on Apple Vision Pro and play a console's games; you supply your own console files and games.

- [Xbawks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/xbawks.md): emulator for Original Xbox games (Xbox); by A.Cervantez (@Ywach404); working; last commit 2026-11-24; plays as 2D; game controller.
- [Holofold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/holofold.md): emulator for Nintendo 3DS games (Other); by @zlinoliver; partially-working; last commit 2026-11-25; plays as 3D shared space (stereo); game controller, hand tracking.
- [720](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/ports/720.md): emulator for Xbox 360 games (Other); by A.Cervantez (@Ywach404); partially-working; last commit 2026-11-22; plays as 2D; game controller.

## For developers

- [How to submit a port](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): one YAML file plus an install guide in your repo (AVP-INSTALL.md, or your README's install section); clean submissions merge automatically.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgytoast/avp-ports-index/main/skills/avp-index-submit/SKILL.md): give it to your coding agent to make your repo ready to list.
